about.longDescription: Dyafa Real Estate Development & Investment is the development and investment arm of the Dyafa ecosystem. Through its public-facing brand, Dyafa Development, the company creates hospitality and hospitality-linked real estate assets that are commercially relevant, operationally viable, and scalable. Its work connects feasibility, site analysis, modular development, investment structuring, development management, and operating readiness into one aligned path from opportunity to operating asset.

modularHospitality.heroHeadline: Modular is not cheap. Modular is disciplined.

faq.q: Does modular mean cheaper or lower quality?
faq.a: No. Modular at Dyafa means repeatable components, standardised development logic, and disciplined delivery — not a reduction in quality or standards.

faq.q: Is a modular hospitality asset temporary?
faq.a: No. Modular describes the delivery method, not the permanence of the asset. Modular assets are built to operate over the long term, like any other hospitality asset.

faq.q: Where does modular development work best?
faq.a: Modular logic supports both major and secondary cities, particularly where practical, well-planned, operation-ready assets are a better fit than a single mega-project.
Repeatable components and standardised development logic make it possible to replicate a proven concept across multiple sites with more predictable cost, quality, and timeline outcomes.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: This policy has not yet completed formal legal review.
privacy.intro: Dyafa Real Estate Development & Investment ("Dyafa Development", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect through this website, why, and the choices available to you under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Contact and submission details you provide through our forms (name, organization, email, phone, city, site/asset details, uploaded documents) and limited technical data (page views, locale, UTM parameters) for analytics.

sections.title: Why we collect it
sections.body: To evaluate and respond to site-review, meeting, contact, talent, and newsletter submissions, and to understand how visitors use the site.

sections.title: Your consent
sections.body: We record the date and time you provide consent on each form. You may withdraw consent and request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.

sections.title: Data retention and deletion
sections.body: Personal data is retained only as long as necessary for the purpose collected. You may request a PDPL data-deletion of your lead record; a record of the deletion action itself is kept for audit purposes without your personal data.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For privacy requests, contact us using the details on our Contact page.
